Subject: POC session recap + actions (prompt routing, load test results)

Hi all — thanks for a productive session. Quick recap and action items:

Summary:
- Walked through prompt routing for triage -> specialist models; validated routing rules for urgency and PHI flagging.
- Ran burst + steady-state load tests: 200-concurrent burst, then 10min at ~30 qps. Results: p50 latency ~220ms, p95 ~430ms on our Dedicated test pool; no errors above 1%.
- Prompt review: adjusted system prompt and added a post-processing reranker to reduce hallucinations on long-context replies.

Action items (owner — ETA):
- Neha: share the updated prompt templates and reranker config (ETA: 2026-03-06).
- Dev: export full load test logs and the ephemeral IP list for your compliance team (ETA: 2026-03-05).
- Marissa: prepare a one-page SLA note and pricing estimate for the Dedicated pool we used (ETA: 2026-03-07).
- Olivia/Marcus: confirm the additional platform attendee and provide any CIDR for isolated testing (ETA: 2026-03-05).

Artifacts: session recording and notes have been uploaded (session-recording-20260303.mp4, notes in Drive). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOCdocs

If anything above needs correction, reply-all and we’ll update. I’ll follow up with the logs and IP list tomorrow.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
